result:
I've planned round 514. The decision is **CONTINUE**: nothing external is blocking, and the remaining scope is still large.

**Round 513 result:** C passed it with browser verification and found 0 bugs, and gate 513 published it at `4c85587`. The cookie banner's Decline/Accept/Close stage is done. That closes two older Low items (A-R183-COOKIE-BUTTON-TYPE, A-R183-REVIEW-FBQ-BRANCH). The backlog is now v520 and the round-513 task is archived as `tasks/round-513.md`.

**Round 514 is the two open Medium bugs on the cookie banner** (same file):
- **Focus is lost after the banner closes.** On HEAD, every way of dismissing it leaves focus on the page body.
  - **Fix:** keyboard focus goes back to wherever the user was before entering the banner. If that element no longer exists, it goes to the header "CZABA" logo, then to the first header link.
  - **Keyboard vs mouse:** with the keyboard the focus ring shows, and the page scrolls only if the target is off-screen. With mouse or tap there is no scroll and no ring.
- **The mobile Close X covers the text** at 320 and 375 px. The fix makes the X 40 px and pads the text so they no longer collide. At 1280 and 1440 the banner is identical to HEAD.

**Why the first design was changed:** product-designer first said "always focus the header logo", assuming the header stays stuck to the top. In the browser I found it doesn't: `app/styles/app.css` l.269–272 (`html, body { overflow-x: hidden }`) breaks the sticky header. That is also the cause of the old deferred Low C-R205-02. Mid-page, the logo would be off-screen with an invisible focus ring. Product-designer re-ruled and approved the version above.

**Checks I ran on the patch:**
- Typecheck and Biome are clean, the covering tests pass (6 files, 99 tests), and lint (171 warnings) and the button scanner (50) are unchanged.
- I mutated the code 15 ways and every mutation failed at least one test.
- In the browser across 22 focus scenarios, HEAD drops focus to the body in all 22; the patch never does.

**Known gaps:**
- Tech-lead approved with changes, and three small follow-up edits were not re-read by them. Mutants and typecheck cover those edits; the task says so.
- Two behaviours are accepted and written into the task as intended:
  - A mouse dismissal mid-page puts focus on the off-screen logo with no ring and no scroll.
  - A keyboard user who never focused anything and Shift+Tabs into the banner mid-page is scrolled to the top.

**Needs Saba:** one new question, in `user-review/questions-round-513.md`: should the mobile Close X keep silently recording a Decline? The default is to keep it, and round 514 does not change it.

**Needs root:** fixing the non-sticky header requires a grant for `app/styles/**`. The earlier request ROOT-REQ-DPG2-APPLIED-NOT-AT-HEAD is still open.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. The store tree is clean and my temporary servers are stopped. After round 514 come the regression round (due 2026-11-16), then the remaining button-cleanup stages, the rest of the design-gate fixes and the later queue.
